evaluation: final frozen V7 held-out test evaluation
metric_implementation: src/evaluate_test.py calculate_metrics; identical existing PSNR/SSIM/UIQM/UCIQE helpers; RGB [0,1]
preprocessing: official paired EUVPPairedDataset and PairedTransform(training=False); RGB ToTensor [0,1]; no resizing or random augmentation
decision_text: V7 shows some test-set candidate variation, but remains strongly biased toward one candidate.
evaluation_execution_note: The first full scoring pass processed all 370 test pairs but stopped during report aggregation on a missing preservation key after inference was complete. The rerun is the reported result; no test-driven tuning occurred.
